verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicat nunc Israel, quóniam bonus, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Let Israel now say that He is good, that His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicat nunc domus Aaron, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Let the house of Aaron now say, that His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicant nunc qui timent Dóminum, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Let them that fear the Lord now say, that His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: De tribulatióne invocávi Dóminum, et exaudívit me in latitúdine Dóminus.
verses.eng: In my trouble I called upon the Lord, and the Lord heard me and enlarged me.

verses.lat: Dóminus mihi adjútor; non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
verses.eng: The Lord is my helper; I will not fear what man can do unto me.

verses.lat: Dóminus mihi adjútor, et ego despíciam inimícos meos.
verses.eng: The Lord is my helper, and I will look over my enemies.

verses.lat: Bonum est confídere in Dómino, quam confídere in hómine.
verses.eng: It is good to confide in the Lord, rather than to have confidence in man.

verses.lat: Bonum est speráre in Dómino, quam speráre in princípibus.
verses.eng: It is good to trust in the Lord, rather than to trust in princes.

verses.lat: Omnes gentes circuiérunt me, et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.eng: All nations compassed me about, and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

verses.lat: Circumdántes circumdedérunt me, et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.eng: Surrounding me they compassed me about, and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me sicut apes, et exarsérunt sicut ignis in spinis, et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.eng: They surrounded me like bees, and they burned like fire among thorns, and in the name of the Lord I was revenged on them.

verses.lat: Impúlsus, eversus sum ut cáderem, et Dóminus suscépit me.
verses.eng: Being pushed I was overturned that I might fall, but the Lord supported me.

verses.lat: Fortitúdo mea et laus mea Dóminus, et factus est mihi in salútem.
verses.eng: The Lord is my strength and my praise, and He is become my salvation.

verses.lat: Vox exsultatiónis et salútis in tabernáculis justórum.
verses.eng: The voice of rejoicing and of salvation is in the tabernacles of the just.

verses.lat: Déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem; déxtera Dómini exaltávit me; déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem.
verses.eng: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength; the right hand of the Lord hath exalted me; the right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength.

verses.lat: Non móriar sed vivam, et narrábo ópera Dómini.
verses.eng: I shall not die, but live, and shall declare the works of the Lord.

verses.lat: Castigans castigávit me Dóminus, et morti non trádidit me.
verses.eng: The Lord chastising hath chastised me, but He hath not delivered me over to death.

verses.lat: Aperíte mihi portas justítiæ; ingréssus in eas confitébor Dómino.
verses.eng: Open ye to me the gates of justice; I will go into them, and give praise to the Lord.

verses.lat: Hæc porta Dómini; justi intrábunt in eam.
verses.eng: This is the gate of the Lord; the just shall enter into it.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi quóniam exaudísti me, et factus es mihi in salútem.
verses.eng: I will give praise to Thee because Thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

verses.lat: Lápidem quem reprobavérunt ædificántes, hic factus est in caput ánguli.
verses.eng: The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner.

verses.lat: A Dómino factum est istud, et est mirábile in óculis nostris.
verses.eng: This is the Lord's doing, and it is wonderful in our eyes.

verses.lat: Hæc est dies quam fecit Dóminus; exsultémus et lætémur in ea.
verses.eng: This is the day which the Lord hath made; let us be glad and rejoice therein.

verses.lat: O Dómine, salvum me fac; o Dómine, bene prosperáre.
verses.eng: O Lord, save me; O Lord, give good success.

verses.lat: Benedíctus qui venit in nómine Dómini. Benedíximus vobis de domo Dómini.
verses.eng: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord. We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

verses.lat: Deus Dóminus, et illúxit nobis. Constitúite diem sollémnem in condénsis usque ad cornu altáris.
verses.eng: The Lord is God, and He hath shone upon us. Appoint a solemn day with shady boughs, even to the horn of the altar.

verses.lat: Deus meus es tu, et confitébor tibi; Deus meus es tu, et exaltábo te.
verses.eng: Thou art my God, and I will praise Thee; Thou art my God, and I will exalt Thee.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: O praise ye the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Beáti immaculáti in via: * qui ámbulant in lege Dómini.
verses.eng: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, * who walk in the law of the Lord.

verses.lat: Beáti, qui scrutántur testimónia ejus: * in toto corde exquírunt eum.
verses.eng: Blessed are they that search His testimonies: * that seek Him with their whole heart.

verses.lat: Non enim qui operántur iniquitátem, * in viis ejus ambula vérunt.
verses.eng: For they that work iniquity * have not walked in His ways.

verses.lat: Tu mandásti * mandáta tua custódi nimis.
verses.eng: Thou hast commanded * Thy commandments to be kept most diligently.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

verses.lat: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sæcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, * world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: In quo córrigit adolescéntior viam suam? * In custodiéndo sermónes tuos.
verses.eng: By what doth a young man correct his way? * By observing Thy words.

verses.lat: In toto corde meo exquisívi te: * ne repéllas me a mandátis tuis.
verses.eng: With my whole heart have I sought after Thee: * let me not stray from Thy commandments.

verses.lat: In corde meo abscóndi elóquia tua: * ut non peccem tibi.
verses.eng: Thy words have I hidden in my heart, * that I may not sin against Thee.

verses.lat: Benedíctus es, Dómine: * doce me justificatiónes tuas.
verses.eng: Blessed art Thou, O Lord: * teach me Thy justifications.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

verses.lat: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sæcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, * world without end. Amen.

parts.lat: Regi sæculórum immortáli et invisíbili, soli Deo honor et glória in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
parts.eng: To the King of ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

name: Tértia
intro: The third hour, when the Holy Ghost descended at Pentecost. The psalmody of Psalm 118 continues through the Little Hours.

Ave María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum. Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Jesus. Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.

Credo in Deum, Patrem omnipoténtem, Creatórem cæli et terræ. Et in Jesum Christum, Fílium ejus únicum, Dóminum nostrum: qui concéptus est de Spíritu Sancto, natus ex María Vírgine, passus sub Póntio Piláto, crucifíxus, mórtuus, et sepúltus: descéndit ad ínferos; tértia die resurréxit a mórtuis; ascéndit ad cælos; sedet ad déxteram Dei Patris omnipoténtis: inde ventúrus est judicáre vivos et mórtuos. Credo in Spíritum Sanctum, sanctam Ecclésiam cathólicam, Sanctórum communiónem, remissiónem peccatórum, carnis resurrectiónem, vitam ætérnam. Amen.
parts.eng:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth. And in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord: who was conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried: He descended into hell; the third day He rose again from the dead; He ascended into heaven; sitteth at the right hand of God the Father almighty: from thence He shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Ghost, the holy Catholic Church, the Communion of Saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Nunc, Sancte, nobis Spíritus
parts.lat:
Nunc, Sancte, nobis Spíritus,
unum Patri cum Fílio,
dignáre promptus íngeri
nostro refúsus péctori. Os, lingua, mens, sensus, vigor,
confessiónem pérsonent;
flamméscat igne cáritas,
accéndat ardor próximos. Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
Come, Holy Ghost, who ever One
reignest with Father and with Son,
it is the hour, our souls possess
with Thy full flood of holiness. Let mouth and tongue, mind, strength, and will,
sound forth our witness to Thy name;
and charity's devouring flame
set all our being in a glow. O Father, that we ask be done,
through Jesus Christ, Thine only Son,
who, with the Holy Ghost and Thee,
shall live and reign eternally. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, * deduc me, Dómine, in sémitam mandatórum tuórum, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, * lead me into the path of Thy commandments, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.lat: Legem pone mihi, Dómine, viam justificatiónum tuárum: et exquíram eam semper.
verses.eng: Set before me for a law the way of thy justifications, O Lord: and I will always seek after it.

verses.lat: Da mihi intelléctum, et scrutábor legem tuam: et custódiam illam in toto corde meo.
verses.eng: Give me understanding, and I will search thy law; and I will keep it with my whole heart.

verses.lat: Deduc me in sémitam mandatórum tuórum: quia ipsam vólui.
verses.eng: Lead me into the path of thy commandments; for this same I have desired.

verses.lat: Inclína cor meum in testimónia tua: et non in avarítiam.
verses.eng: Incline my heart into thy testimonies and not to covetousness.

verses.lat: Avérte óculos meos ne vídeant vanitátem: in via tua vivífica me.
verses.eng: Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity: quicken me in thy way.

verses.lat: Státue servo tuo elóquium tuum, in timóre tuo.
verses.eng: Establish thy word to thy servant, in thy fear.

verses.lat: Ámputa oppróbrium meum quod suspicátus sum: quia judícia tua jucúnda.
verses.eng: Turn away my reproach, which I have apprehended: for thy judgments are delightful.

verses.lat: Ecce, concupívi mandáta tua: in æquitáte tua vivífica me.
verses.eng: Behold I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy justice.

verses.lat: Et véniat super me misericórdia tua, Dómine: salutáre tuum secúndum elóquium tuum.
verses.eng: Let thy mercy also come upon me, O Lord: thy salvation according to thy word.

verses.lat: Et respondébo exprobrántibus mihi verbum: quia sperávi in sermónibus tuis.
verses.eng: So shall I answer them that reproach me in any thing; that I have trusted in thy words.

verses.lat: Et ne áuferas de ore meo verbum veritátis usquequáque: quia in judíciis tuis supersperávi.
verses.eng: And take not thou the word of truth utterly out of my mouth: for in thy words, I have hoped exceedingly.

verses.lat: Et custódiam legem tuam semper: in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: So shall I always keep thy law, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Et ambulábam in latitúdine: quia mandáta tua exquisívi.
verses.eng: And I walked at large: because I have sought after thy commandments.

verses.lat: Et loquébar in testimóniis tuis in conspéctu regum: et non confundébar.
verses.eng: And I spoke of thy testimonies before kings: and I was not ashamed.

verses.lat: Et meditábar in mandátis tuis, quæ diléxi.
verses.eng: I meditated also on thy commandments, which I loved.

verses.lat: Et levávi manus meas ad mandáta tua, quæ diléxi: et exercébar in justificatiónibus tuis.
verses.eng: And I lifted up my hands to thy commandments, which I loved: and I was exercised in thy justifications.

verses.lat: Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, in quo mihi spem dedísti.
verses.eng: Be thou mindful of thy word to thy servant, in which thou hast given me hope.

verses.lat: Hæc me consoláta est in humilitáte mea: quia elóquium tuum vivificávit me.
verses.eng: This hath comforted me in my humiliation: because thy word hath enlivened me.

verses.lat: Supérbi iníque agébant usquequáque: a lege autem tua non declinávi.
verses.eng: The proud did iniquitously altogether: but I declined not from thy law.

verses.lat: Memor fui judiciórum tuórum a sǽculo, Dómine: et consolátus sum.
verses.eng: I remembered, O Lord, thy judgments of old: and I was comforted.

verses.lat: Deféctio ténuit me, pro peccatóribus derelinquéntibus legem tuam.
verses.eng: A fainting hath taken hold of me, because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

verses.lat: Cantábiles mihi erant justificatiónes tuæ, in loco peregrinatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: Thy justifications were the subject of my song, in the place of my pilgrimage.

verses.lat: Memor fui nocte nóminis tui, Dómine: et custodívi legem tuam.
verses.eng: In the night I have remembered thy name, O Lord: and have kept thy law.

verses.lat: Hæc facta est mihi: quia justificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
verses.eng: This happened to me: because I sought after thy justifications.

verses.lat: Pórtio mea, Dómine, dixi custodíre legem tuam.
verses.eng: O Lord, my portion, I have said, I would keep thy law.

verses.lat: Deprecátus sum fáciem tuam in toto corde meo: miserére mei secúndum elóquium tuum.
verses.eng: I entreated thy face with all my heart: have mercy on me according to thy word.

verses.lat: Cogitávi vias meas: et convérti pedes meos in testimónia tua.
verses.eng: I have thought on my ways: and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

verses.lat: Parátus sum, et non sum turbátus: ut custódiam mandáta tua.
verses.eng: I am ready, and am not troubled: that I may keep thy commandments.

verses.lat: Funes peccatórum circumpléxi sunt me: et legem tuam non sum oblítus.
verses.eng: The cords of the wicked have encompassed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.lat: Média nocte surgébam ad confiténdum tibi, super judícia justificatiónis tuæ.
verses.eng: I rose at midnight to give praise to thee; for the judgments of thy justification.

verses.lat: Párticeps ego sum ómnium timéntium te: et custodiéntium mandáta tua.
verses.eng: I am a partaker with all them that fear thee, and that keep thy commandments.

verses.lat: Misericórdia tua, Dómine, plena est terra: justificatiónes tuas doce me.
verses.eng: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy justifications.

verses.lat: Bonitátem fecísti cum servo tuo, Dómine, secúndum verbum tuum.
verses.eng: Thou hast done well with thy servant, O Lord, according to thy word.

verses.lat: Bonitátem, et disciplínam, et sciéntiam doce me: quia mandátis tuis crédidi.
verses.eng: Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge; for I have believed thy commandments.

verses.lat: Priúsquam humiliárer ego delíqui: proptérea elóquium tuum custodívi.
verses.eng: Before I was humbled I offended; therefore have I kept thy word.

verses.lat: Bonus es tu: et in bonitáte tua doce me justificatiónes tuas.
verses.eng: Thou art good; and in thy goodness teach me thy justifications.

verses.lat: Multiplicáta est super me iníquitas superbórum: ego autem in toto corde meo scrutábor mandáta tua.
verses.eng: The iniquity of the proud hath been multiplied over me: but I will seek thy commandments with my whole heart.

verses.lat: Coagulátum est sicut lac cor eórum: ego vero legem tuam meditátus sum.
verses.eng: Their heart is curdled like milk: but I have meditated on thy law.

verses.lat: Bonum mihi quia humiliásti me: ut discam justificatiónes tuas.
verses.eng: It is good for me that thou hast humbled me, that I may learn thy justifications.

verses.lat: Bonum mihi lex oris tui, super míllia auri et argénti.
verses.eng: The law of thy mouth is good to me, above thousands of gold and silver.

verses.lat: Manus tuæ fecérunt me, et plasmavérunt me: da mihi intelléctum, et discam mandáta tua.
verses.eng: Thy hands have made me and formed me: give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.

verses.lat: Qui timent te vidébunt me, et lætabúntur: quia in verba tua supersperávi.
verses.eng: They that fear thee shall see me, and shall be glad: because I have greatly hoped in thy words.

verses.lat: Cognóvi, Dómine, quia ǽquitas judícia tua: et in veritáte tua humiliásti me.
verses.eng: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are equity: and in thy truth thou hast humbled me.

verses.lat: Fiat misericórdia tua ut consolétur me, secúndum elóquium tuum servo tuo.
verses.eng: O! let thy mercy be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

verses.lat: Véniant mihi miseratiónes tuæ, et vivam: quia lex tua meditátio mea est.
verses.eng: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, and I shall live: for thy law is my meditation.

verses.lat: Confundántur supérbi, quia injúste iniquitátem fecérunt in me: ego autem exercébor in mandátis tuis.
verses.eng: Let the proud be ashamed, because they have done unjustly towards me: but I will be employed in thy commandments.

verses.lat: Convertántur mihi timéntes te: et qui novérunt testimónia tua.
verses.eng: Let them that fear thee turn to me: and they that know thy testimonies.

verses.lat: Fiat cor meum immaculátum in justificatiónibus tuis, ut non confúndar.
verses.eng: Let my heart be undefiled in thy justifications, that I may not be confounded.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Deus cáritas est: et qui manet in caritáte, in Deo manet, et Deus in eo.
parts.eng: God is charity: and he that abideth in charity, abideth in God, and God in him.

parts.label: Responsorium Breve
parts.lat:
℟.br. Inclína cor meum, Deus, * in testimónia tua.
℣. Avérte óculos meos ne vídeant vanitátem: in via tua vivífica me.
℟. In testimónia tua.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Inclína cor meum, Deus, * in testimónia tua.
parts.eng:
℟.br. Incline my heart, O God, * unto Thy testimonies.
℣. Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity: quicken me in Thy way.
℟. Unto Thy testimonies.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Incline my heart, O God, * unto Thy testimonies.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: ℣. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
parts.eng: ℣. I said: O Lord, be Thou merciful to me.
parts.latR: ℟. Sana ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
parts.engR: ℟. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against Thee.

parts.lat: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
parts.eng: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
parts.label: Pater Noster
parts.rubric: Said silently.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

name: Sexta
intro: The sixth hour — noon. Our Lord was nailed to the Cross at this hour. A pause in the day to remember His sacrifice.

parts.lat:
Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.

Credo in Deum, Patrem omnipoténtem, Creatórem cæli et terræ. Et in Jesum Christum, Fílium ejus únicum, Dóminum nostrum: qui concéptus est de Spíritu Sancto, natus ex María Vírgine, passus sub Póntio Piláto, crucifíxus, mórtuus, et sepúltus: descéndit ad ínferos; tértia die resurréxit a mórtuis; ascéndit ad cælos; sedet ad déxteram Dei Patris omnipoténtis: inde ventúrus est judicáre vivos et mórtuos. Credo in Spíritum Sanctum, sanctam Ecclésiam cathólicam, Sanctórum communiónem, remissiónem peccatórum, carnis resurrectiónem, vitam ætérnam. Amen.
parts.eng:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth. And in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord: who was conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried: He descended into hell; the third day He rose again from the dead; He ascended into heaven; sitteth at the right hand of God the Father almighty: from thence He shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Ghost, the holy Catholic Church, the Communion of Saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Rector potens, verax Deus
parts.lat:
Rector potens, verax Deus,
qui témperas rerum vices,
splendóre mane illúminas,
et ígnibus merídiem. Exstíngue flammas lítium,
aufer calórem nóxium,
confer salútem córporum,
verámque pacem córdium. Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
O God of truth, O Lord of might,
who orderest time and change aright,
who sendest the early morning ray,
and lightest with splendour all the day. Extinguish Thou each sinful fire,
and banish every ill desire;
and while Thou keepest the body whole,
shed forth Thy peace upon the soul. O Father, that we ask be done,
through Jesus Christ, Thine only Son,
who, with the Holy Ghost and Thee,
shall live and reign eternally. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, * tuus sum ego, salvum me fac, Dómine, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, * I am Thine, save Thou me, O Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.lat: Defécit in salutáre tuum ánima mea: et in verbum tuum supersperávi.
verses.eng: My soul hath fainted after thy salvation: and in thy word I have very much hoped.

verses.lat: Defecérunt óculi mei in elóquium tuum, dicéntes: Quando consoláberis me?
verses.eng: My eyes have failed for thy word, saying: When wilt thou comfort me?

verses.lat: Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruína: justificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
verses.eng: For I am become like a bottle in the frost: I have not forgotten thy justifications.

verses.lat: Quot sunt dies servi tui? quando fácies de persequéntibus me judícium?
verses.eng: How many are the days of thy servant: when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.lat: Narravérunt mihi iníqui fabulatiónes: sed non ut lex tua.
verses.eng: The wicked have told me fables: but not as thy law.

verses.lat: Ómnia mandáta tua véritas: iníque persecúti sunt me, ádjuva me.
verses.eng: All thy statutes are truth: they have persecuted me unjustly, do thou help me.

verses.lat: Paulo minus consummavérunt me in terra: ego autem non derelíqui mandáta tua.
verses.eng: They had almost made an end of me upon earth: but I have not forsaken thy commandments.

verses.lat: Secúndum misericórdiam tuam vivífica me: et custódiam testimónia oris tui.
verses.eng: Quicken thou me according to thy mercy: and I shall keep the testimonies of thy mouth.

verses.lat: In ætérnum, Dómine, verbum tuum pérmanet in cælo.
verses.eng: For ever, O Lord, thy word standeth firm in heaven.

verses.lat: In generatiónem et generatiónem véritas tua: fundásti terram, et pérmanet.
verses.eng: Thy truth unto all generations: thou hast founded the earth, and it continueth.

verses.lat: Ordinatióne tua persevérat dies: quóniam ómnia sérviunt tibi.
verses.eng: By thy ordinance the day goeth on: for all things serve thee.

verses.lat: Nisi quod lex tua meditátio mea est: tunc forte periíssem in humilitáte mea.
verses.eng: Unless thy law had been my meditation, I had then perhaps perished in my abjection.

verses.lat: In ætérnum non oblivíscar justificatiónes tuas: quia in ipsis vivificásti me.
verses.eng: Thy justifications I will never forget: for by them thou hast given me life.

verses.lat: Tuus sum ego, salvum me fac: quóniam justificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
verses.eng: I am thine, save thou me: for I have sought thy justifications.

verses.lat: Me exspectavérunt peccatóres ut pérderent me: testimónia tua intelléxi.
verses.eng: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I have understood thy testimonies.

verses.lat: Omnis consummatiónis vidi finem: latum mandátum tuum nimis.
verses.eng: I have seen an end of all perfection: thy commandment is exceeding broad.

verses.lat: Quómodo diléxi legem tuam, Dómine? tota die meditátio mea est.
verses.eng: How have I loved thy law, O Lord! it is my meditation all the day.

verses.lat: Super inimícos meos prudéntem me fecísti mandáto tuo: quia in ætérnum mihi est.
verses.eng: Through thy commandment, thou hast made me wiser than my enemies: for it is ever with me.

verses.lat: Super omnes docéntes me intelléxi: quia testimónia tua meditátio mea est.
verses.eng: I have understood more than all my teachers: because thy testimonies are my meditation.

verses.lat: Super senes intelléxi: quia mandáta tua quæsívi.
verses.eng: I have had understanding above ancients: because I have sought thy commandments.

verses.lat: Ab omni via mala prohíbui pedes meos: ut custódiam verba tua.
verses.eng: I have restrained my feet from every evil way: that I may keep thy words.

verses.lat: A judíciis tuis non declinávi: quia tu legem posuísti mihi.
verses.eng: I have not declined from thy judgments, because thou hast set me a law.

verses.lat: Quam dúlcia fáucibus meis elóquia tua, super mel ori meo!
verses.eng: How sweet are thy words to my palate! more than honey to my mouth.

verses.lat: A mandátis tuis intelléxi: proptérea odívi omnem viam iniquitátis.
verses.eng: By thy commandments I have had understanding: therefore have I hated every way of iniquity.

verses.lat: Lucérna pédibus meis verbum tuum, et lumen sémitis meis.
verses.eng: Thy word is a lamp to my feet, and a light to my paths.

verses.lat: Jurávi, et státui custodíre judícia justítiæ tuæ.
verses.eng: I have sworn and am determined to keep the judgments of thy justice.

verses.lat: Humiliátus sum usquequáque, Dómine: vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.
verses.eng: I have been humbled, O Lord, exceedingly: quicken thou me according to thy word.

verses.lat: Voluntária oris mei beneplácita fac, Dómine: et judícia tua doce me.
verses.eng: The free offerings of my mouth make acceptable, O Lord: and teach me thy judgments.

verses.lat: Ánima mea in mánibus meis semper: et legem tuam non sum oblítus.
verses.eng: My soul is continually in my hands: and I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.lat: Posuérunt peccatóres láqueum mihi: et de mandátis tuis non errávi.
verses.eng: Sinners have laid a snare for me: but I have not erred from thy precepts.

verses.lat: Hereditáte acquisívi testimónia tua in ætérnum: quia exsultátio cordis mei sunt.
verses.eng: I have purchased thy testimonies for an inheritance for ever: because they are the joy of my heart.

verses.lat: Inclinávi cor meum ad faciéndas justificatiónes tuas in ætérnum, propter retributiónem.
verses.eng: I have inclined my heart to do thy justifications for ever, for the reward.

verses.lat: Iníquos ódio hábui: et legem tuam diléxi.
verses.eng: I have hated the unjust: and I have loved thy law.

verses.lat: Adjútor et suscéptor meus es tu: et in verbum tuum supersperávi.
verses.eng: Thou art my helper and my protector: and in thy word I have greatly hoped.

verses.lat: Declináte a me, malígni: et scrutábor mandáta Dei mei.
verses.eng: Depart from me, ye malignant: and I will search the commandments of my God.

verses.lat: Súscipe me secúndum elóquium tuum, et vivam: et non confúndas me ab exspectatióne mea.
verses.eng: Uphold me according to thy word, and I shall live: and let me not be confounded in my expectation.

verses.lat: Ádjuva me, et salvus ero: et meditábor in justificatiónibus tuis semper.
verses.eng: Help me, and I shall be saved: and I will meditate always on thy justifications.

verses.lat: Sprevísti omnes discedéntes a judíciis tuis: quia injústa cogitátio eórum.
verses.eng: Thou hast despised all them that fall off from thy judgments; for their thought is unjust.

verses.lat: Prævaricántes reputávi omnes peccatóres terræ: ídeo diléxi testimónia tua.
verses.eng: I have accounted all the sinners of the earth prevaricators: therefore have I loved thy testimonies.

verses.lat: Confíge timóre tuo carnes meas: a judíciis enim tuis tímui.
verses.eng: Pierce thou my flesh with thy fear: for I am afraid of thy judgments.

verses.lat: Feci judícium et justítiam: non tradas me calumniántibus me.
verses.eng: I have done judgment and justice: give me not up to them that slander me.

verses.lat: Súscipe servum tuum in bonum: non calumniéntur me supérbi.
verses.eng: Uphold thy servant unto good: let not the proud calumniate me.

verses.lat: Óculi mei defecérunt in salutáre tuum: et in elóquium justítiæ tuæ.
verses.eng: My eyes have fainted after thy salvation: and for the word of thy justice.

verses.lat: Fac cum servo tuo secúndum misericórdiam tuam: et justificatiónes tuas doce me.
verses.eng: Deal with thy servant according to thy mercy: and teach me thy justifications.

verses.lat: Servus tuus sum ego: da mihi intelléctum, ut sciam testimónia tua.
verses.eng: I am thy servant: give me understanding that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.lat: Tempus faciéndi, Dómine: dissipavérunt legem tuam.
verses.eng: It is time, O Lord, to do: they have dissipated thy law.

verses.lat: Ídeo diléxi mandáta tua, super aurum et topázion.
verses.eng: Therefore have I loved thy commandments above gold and the topaz.

verses.lat: Proptérea ad ómnia mandáta tua dirigébar: omnem viam iníquam ódio hábui.
verses.eng: Therefore was I directed to all thy commandments: I have hated all wicked ways.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Alter altérius ónera portáte, et sic adimplébitis legem Christi.
parts.eng: Bear ye one another's burdens; and so you shall fulfill the law of Christ.

parts.label: Responsorium Breve
parts.lat:
℟.br. In ætérnum, Dómine, * pérmanet verbum tuum.
℣. In sǽculum sǽculi véritas tua.
℟. Pérmanet verbum tuum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. In ætérnum, Dómine, * pérmanet verbum tuum.
parts.eng:
℟.br. For ever, O Lord, * Thy word standeth firm in heaven.
℣. Thy truth for ever and ever.
℟. Thy word standeth firm in heaven.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. For ever, O Lord, * Thy word standeth firm in heaven.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: ℣. Dóminus regit me, et nihil mihi déerit.
parts.eng: ℣. The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing.
parts.latR: ℟. In loco páscuæ ibi me collocávit.
parts.engR: ℟. He hath set me in a place of pasture.

parts.lat: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
parts.eng: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

name: Nona
intro: The ninth hour — three in the afternoon. Our Lord died upon the Cross at this hour.

parts.label: Pater Noster, Ave María, Credo
parts.lat:
Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.

Ave María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum. Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Jesus. Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.

Credo in Deum, Patrem omnipoténtem, Creatórem cæli et terræ. Et in Jesum Christum, Fílium ejus únicum, Dóminum nostrum: qui concéptus est de Spíritu Sancto, natus ex María Vírgine, passus sub Póntio Piláto, crucifíxus, mórtuus, et sepúltus: descéndit ad ínferos; tértia die resurréxit a mórtuis; ascéndit ad cælos; sedet ad déxteram Dei Patris omnipoténtis: inde ventúrus est judicáre vivos et mórtuos. Credo in Spíritum Sanctum, sanctam Ecclésiam cathólicam, Sanctórum communiónem, remissiónem peccatórum, carnis resurrectiónem, vitam ætérnam. Amen.
parts.eng:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth. And in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord: who was conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried: He descended into hell; the third day He rose again from the dead; He ascended into heaven; sitteth at the right hand of God the Father almighty: from thence He shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Ghost, the holy Catholic Church, the Communion of Saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Rerum Deus tenax vigor
parts.lat:
Rerum Deus tenax vigor,
immótus in te pérmanens,
lucis diúrnæ témpora
succéssibus detérminans. Largíre clarum véspere,
quo vita nusquam décidat,
sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
perénnis instet glória. Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
O strength and stay upholding all creation,
who ever dost Thyself unmoved abide,
yet day by day the light in due gradation
from hour to hour through all its changes guide. Grant to life's day a calm unclouded ending,
an eve untouched by shadows of decay,
the brightness of a holy deathbed blending
with dawning glories of th'eternal day. O Father, that we ask be done,
through Jesus Christ, Thine only Son,
who, with the Holy Ghost and Thee,
shall live and reign eternally. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Allelúja, * fáciem tuam, Dómine, illúmina super servum tuum, allelúja, allelúja.
parts.eng: Alleluia, * make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.lat: Mirabília testimónia tua: ídeo scrutáta est ea ánima mea.
verses.eng: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore my soul hath sought them.

verses.lat: Declarátio sermónum tuórum illúminat: et intelléctum dat párvulis.
verses.eng: The declaration of thy words giveth light: and giveth understanding to little ones.

verses.lat: Os meum apérui, et attráxi spíritum: quia mandáta tua desiderábam.
verses.eng: I opened my mouth, and panted: because I longed for thy commandments.

verses.lat: Áspice in me, et miserére mei, secúndum judícium diligéntium nomen tuum.
verses.eng: Look thou upon me, and have mercy on me, according to the judgment of them that love thy name.

verses.lat: Gressus meos dírige secúndum elóquium tuum: et non dominétur mei omnis injustítia.
verses.eng: Direct my steps according to thy word: and let no iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.lat: Rédime me a calúmniis hóminum: ut custódiam mandáta tua.
verses.eng: Redeem me from the calumnies of men: that I may keep thy commandments.

verses.lat: Fáciem tuam illúmina super servum tuum: et doce me justificatiónes tuas.
verses.eng: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: and teach me thy justifications.

verses.lat: Éxitus aquárum deduxérunt óculi mei: quia non custodiérunt legem tuam.
verses.eng: My eyes have sent forth springs of water: because they have not kept thy law.

verses.lat: Justus es, Dómine: et rectum judícium tuum.
verses.eng: Thou art just, O Lord: and thy judgment is right.

verses.lat: Mandásti justítiam testimónia tua: et veritátem tuam nimis.
verses.eng: Thou hast commanded justice thy testimonies: and thy truth exceedingly.

verses.lat: Tabéscere me fecit zelus meus: quia oblíti sunt verba tua inimíci mei.
verses.eng: My zeal hath made me pine away: because my enemies forgot thy words.

verses.lat: Ignítum elóquium tuum veheménter: et servus tuus diléxit illud.
verses.eng: Thy word is exceedingly refined: and thy servant hath loved it.

verses.lat: Adolescéntulus sum ego et contémptus: justificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
verses.eng: I am very young and despised; but I forget not thy justifications.

verses.lat: Justítia tua, justítia in ætérnum: et lex tua véritas.
verses.eng: Thy justice is justice for ever: and thy law is the truth.

verses.lat: Tribulátio, et angústia invenérunt me: mandáta tua meditátio mea est.
verses.eng: Trouble and anguish have found me: thy commandments are my meditation.

verses.lat: Ǽquitas testimónia tua in ætérnum: intelléctum da mihi, et vivam.
verses.eng: Thy testimonies are justice for ever: give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.lat: Clamávi in toto corde meo, exáudi me, Dómine: justificatiónes tuas requíram.
verses.eng: I cried with my whole heart, hear me, O Lord: I will seek thy justifications.

verses.lat: Clamávi ad te, salvum me fac: ut custódiam mandáta tua.
verses.eng: I cried unto thee, save me: that I may keep thy commandments.

verses.lat: Prævéni in maturitáte, et clamávi: quia in verba tua supersperávi.
verses.eng: I prevented the dawning of the day, and cried: because in thy words I very much hoped.

verses.lat: Prævenérunt óculi mei ad te dilúculo: ut meditárer elóquia tua.
verses.eng: My eyes to thee have prevented the morning: that I might meditate on thy words.

verses.lat: Vocem meam audi secúndum misericórdiam tuam, Dómine: et secúndum judícium tuum vivífica me.
verses.eng: Hear thou my voice, O Lord, according to thy mercy: and quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.lat: Appropinquavérunt persequéntes me iniquitáti: a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.
verses.eng: They that persecute me have drawn nigh to iniquity; but they are gone far off from thy law.

verses.lat: Prope es tu, Dómine: et omnes viæ tuæ véritas.
verses.eng: Thou art near, O Lord: and all thy ways are truth.

verses.lat: Inítio cognóvi de testimóniis tuis: quia in ætérnum fundásti ea.
verses.eng: I have known from the beginning concerning thy testimonies: that thou hast founded them for ever.

verses.lat: Vide humilitátem meam, et éripe me: quia legem tuam non sum oblítus.
verses.eng: See my humiliation and deliver me: for I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.lat: Júdica judícium meum, et rédime me: propter elóquium tuum vivífica me.
verses.eng: Judge my judgment and redeem me: quicken thou me for thy word’s sake.

verses.lat: Longe a peccatóribus salus: quia justificatiónes tuas non exquisiérunt.
verses.eng: Salvation is far from sinners; because they have not sought thy justifications.

verses.lat: Misericórdiæ tuæ multæ, Dómine: secúndum judícium tuum vivífica me.
verses.eng: Many, O Lord, are thy mercies: quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.lat: Multi qui persequúntur me, et tríbulant me: a testimóniis tuis non declinávi.
verses.eng: Many are they that persecute me, and afflict me; but I have not declined from thy testimonies.

verses.lat: Vidi prævaricántes, et tabescébam: quia elóquia tua non custodiérunt.
verses.eng: I beheld the transgressors, and I pined away; because they kept not thy word.

verses.lat: Vide quóniam mandáta tua diléxi, Dómine: in misericórdia tua vivífica me.
verses.eng: Behold I have loved thy commandments, O Lord; quicken me thou in thy mercy.

verses.lat: Princípium verbórum tuórum, véritas: in ætérnum ómnia judícia justítiæ tuæ.
verses.eng: The beginning of thy words is truth: all the judgments of thy justice are for ever.

verses.lat: Príncipes persecúti sunt me gratis: et a verbis tuis formidávit cor meum.
verses.eng: Princes have persecuted me without cause: and my heart hath been in awe of thy words.

verses.lat: Lætábor ego super elóquia tua: sicut qui invénit spólia multa.
verses.eng: I will rejoice at thy words, as one that hath found great spoil.

verses.lat: Iniquitátem ódio hábui, et abominátus sum: legem autem tuam diléxi.
verses.eng: I have hated and abhorred iniquity; but I have loved thy law.

verses.lat: Sépties in die laudem dixi tibi, super judícia justítiæ tuæ.
verses.eng: Seven times a day I have given praise to thee, for the judgments of thy justice.

verses.lat: Pax multa diligéntibus legem tuam: et non est illis scándalum.
verses.eng: Much peace have they that love thy law, and to them there is no stumbling-block.

verses.lat: Exspectábam salutáre tuum, Dómine: et mandáta tua diléxi.
verses.eng: I looked for thy salvation, O Lord: and I loved thy commandments.

verses.lat: Custodívit ánima mea testimónia tua: et diléxit ea veheménter.
verses.eng: My soul hath kept thy testimonies: and hath loved them exceedingly.

verses.lat: Servávi mandáta tua, et testimónia tua: quia omnes viæ meæ in conspéctu tuo.
verses.eng: I have kept thy commandments and thy testimonies: because all my ways are in thy sight.

verses.lat: Appropínquet deprecátio mea in conspéctu tuo, Dómine: juxta elóquium tuum da mihi intelléctum.
verses.eng: Let my supplication, O Lord, come near in thy sight: give me understanding according to thy word.

verses.lat: Intret postulátio mea in conspéctu tuo: secúndum elóquium tuum éripe me.
verses.eng: Let my request come in before thee; deliver thou me according to thy word.

verses.lat: Eructábunt lábia mea hymnum, cum docúeris me justificatiónes tuas.
verses.eng: My lips shall utter a hymn, when thou shalt teach me thy justifications.

verses.lat: Pronuntiábit lingua mea elóquium tuum: quia ómnia mandáta tua ǽquitas.
verses.eng: My tongue shall pronounce thy word: because all thy commandments are justice.

verses.lat: Fiat manus tua ut salvet me: quóniam mandáta tua elégi.
verses.eng: Let thy hand be with me to save me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

verses.lat: Concupívi salutáre tuum, Dómine: et lex tua meditátio mea est.
verses.eng: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my meditation.

verses.lat: Vivet ánima mea, et laudábit te: et judícia tua adjuvábunt me.
verses.eng: My soul shall live and shall praise thee: and thy judgments shall help me.

verses.lat: Errávi, sicut ovis, quæ périit: quære servum tuum, quia mandáta tua non sum oblítus.
verses.eng: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost: seek thy servant, because I have not forgotten thy commandments.

parts.label: Psalm 109; Dixit Dóminus

verses.lat: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis:
verses.eng: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit Thou at My right hand:

verses.lat: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, scabéllum pedum tuórum.
verses.eng: Until I make Thy enemies Thy footstool.

verses.lat: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
verses.eng: The Lord will send forth the sceptre of Thy power out of Sion: rule Thou in the midst of Thy enemies.

verses.lat: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
verses.eng: With Thee is the principality in the day of Thy strength, in the brightness of the saints: from the womb before the day star I begot Thee.

verses.lat: Jurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
verses.eng: The Lord hath sworn, and He will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

verses.lat: Dóminus a dextris tuis, confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.

verses.lat: Judicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.

verses.lat: De torrénte in via bibet: proptérea exaltábit caput.
verses.eng: He shall drink of the torrent in the way: therefore shall He lift up the head.

parts.antiphonLat: Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis.
parts.antiphonEng: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand.

parts.label: Psalmus 110; Confitébor tibi

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo, in consílio justórum et congregatióne.
verses.eng: I will praise Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart, in the council of the just and in the congregation.

verses.lat: Magna ópera Dómini, exquisíta in omnes voluntátes ejus.
verses.eng: Great are the works of the Lord, sought out according to all His wills.

verses.lat: Conféssio et magnificéntia opus ejus, et justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: His work is praise and magnificence, and His justice continueth for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: escam dedit timéntibus se.
verses.eng: He hath made a remembrance of His wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord: He hath given food to them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
verses.eng: He will be mindful for ever of His covenant: He will shew forth to His people the power of His works.

verses.lat: Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: ópera mánuum ejus véritas et judícium.
verses.eng: That He may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: the works of His hands are truth and judgment.

verses.lat: Fidélia ómnia mandáta ejus, confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
verses.eng: All His commandments are faithful, confirmed for ever and ever, made in truth and equity.

verses.lat: Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
verses.eng: He hath sent redemption to His people: He hath commanded His covenant for ever.

verses.lat: Sanctum et terríbile nomen ejus: inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
verses.eng: Holy and terrible is His name: the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

verses.lat: Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: laudátio ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: A good understanding to all that do it: His praise continueth for ever and ever.

parts.antiphonLat: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes ejus.
parts.antiphonEng: Great are the works of the Lord, * sought out according to all his wills.

parts.label: Psalmus 111; Beátus vir

verses.lat: Beátus vir qui timet Dóminum: in mandátis ejus volet nimis.
verses.eng: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord: he shall delight exceedingly in His commandments.

verses.lat: Potens in terra erit semen ejus: generátio rectórum benedicétur.
verses.eng: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

verses.lat: Glória et divítiæ in domo ejus, et justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Glory and wealth shall be in his house, and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: miséricors, et miserátor, et justus.
verses.eng: To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: he is merciful, and compassionate, and just.

verses.lat: Jucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in judício: quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
verses.eng: Acceptable is the man that showeth mercy and lendeth; he shall order his words with judgment, because he shall not be moved for ever.

verses.lat: In memória ætérna erit justus: ab auditióne mala non timébit.
verses.eng: The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: he shall not fear the evil hearing.

verses.lat: Parátum cor ejus speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor ejus: non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
verses.eng: His heart is ready to hope in the Lord; his heart is strengthened: he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

verses.lat: Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi; cornu ejus exaltábitur in glória.
verses.eng: He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: his justice remaineth for ever and ever; his horn shall be exalted in glory.

verses.lat: Peccátor vidébit et irascétur; déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: desidérium peccatórum períbit.
verses.eng: The wicked shall see and shall be angry; he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

parts.antiphonLat: Qui timet Dóminum, * in mandátis ejus cupit nimis.
parts.antiphonEng: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

parts.label: Psalmus 112; Laudáte púeri

verses.lat: Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: laudáte nomen Dómini.
verses.eng: Praise the Lord, ye children: praise ye the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: Blessed be the name of the Lord, from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.lat: A solis ortu usque ad occásum, laudábile nomen Dómini.
verses.eng: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

verses.lat: Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, et super cælos glória ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord is high above all nations, and His glory above the heavens.

verses.lat: Quis sicut Dóminus Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
verses.eng: Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high, and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

verses.lat: Súscitans a terra ínopem, et de stércore érigens páuperem:
verses.eng: Raising up the needy from the earth, and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:

verses.lat: Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, cum princípibus pópuli sui.
verses.eng: That He may place him with princes, with the princes of His people.

verses.lat: Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, matrem filiórum lætántem.
verses.eng: Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, the joyful mother of children.

parts.antiphonLat: Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sǽcula.
parts.antiphonEng: Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

parts.label: Psalmus 113; In éxitu Israël

verses.lat: In éxitu Israël de Ægýpto, * domus Jacob de pópulo bárbaro.
verses.eng: When Israel went out of Egypt, * the house of Jacob from a barbarous people.

verses.lat: Facta est Judæa sanctificátio ejus, * Israël potéstas ejus.
verses.eng: Judea was made His sanctuary, * Israel His dominion.

verses.lat: Mare vidit et fugit: * Jordánis convérsus est retrórsum.
verses.eng: The sea saw and fled: * Jordan was turned back.

verses.lat: Montes exsulta vérunt ut aríetes: * et colles sicut agni óvium.
verses.eng: The mountains skipped like rams, * and the hills like the lambs of the flock.

verses.lat: Non nobis, Dómine, non nobis: * sed nómini tuo da glóriam.
verses.eng: Not to us, O Lord, not to us: * but to Thy name give glory.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

verses.lat: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sæcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, * world without end. Amen.

parts.antiphonLat: Deus autem noster * in cælo: ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
parts.antiphonEng: But our God is in heaven, * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Jesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
parts.eng: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Lucis Creátor óptime
parts.lat:
Lucis Creátor óptime,
lucem diérum próferens,
primórdiis lucis novæ,
mundi parans oríginem. Qui mane junctum vésperi
diem vocári prǽcipis:
illǽbitur tetrum chaos,
audi preces cum flétibus. Ne mens graváta crímine
vitæ sit exsul múnere,
dum nil perénne cógitat,
sesé que culpis ílligat. Cæléstem pulsent jánuam,
vitále tollant prǽmium;
vitémus omne nóxium,
purgémus omne péssimum. Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
O blest Creator of the light,
who mak'st the day with radiance bright,
and o'er the forming world didst call
the light from chaos first of all. Whose wisdom joined in meet array
the morn and eve, and named them day:
night comes with all its darkling fears,
regard Thy people's prayers and tears. Lest, sunk in sin, and whelmed with strife,
they lose the gift of endless life;
while thinking but the thoughts of time,
they weave new chains of woe and crime. But grant them grace that they may strain
the heavenly gate and prize to gain;
each harmful lure aside to cast,
and purge away each error past. O Father, that we ask be done,
through Jesus Christ, Thine only Son,
who, with the Holy Ghost and Thee,
shall live and reign eternally. Amen.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Dirigátur, Dómine, orátio mea.
parts.eng: Let my prayer be directed, O Lord.

parts.label: Antiphon ad Magnificat
parts.lat: Magníficat ánima mea Dóminum.
parts.eng: My soul doth magnify the Lord.

verses.lat: Magníficat ánima mea Dóminum:
verses.eng: My soul doth magnify the Lord:

verses.lat: Et exsultávit spíritus meus in Deo salutári meo.
verses.eng: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

verses.lat: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
verses.eng: Because He hath regarded the humility of His handmaid: for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

verses.lat: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: et sanctum nomen ejus.
verses.eng: Because He that is mighty hath done great things to me: and holy is His name.

verses.lat: Et misericórdia ejus a progénie in progénies timéntibus eum.
verses.eng: And His mercy is from generation unto generations, to them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Fecit poténtiam in bráchio suo: dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
verses.eng: He hath showed might in His arm: He hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

verses.lat: Depósuit poténtes de sede, et exaltávit húmiles.
verses.eng: He hath put down the mighty from their seat, and hath exalted the humble.

verses.lat: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: et dívites dimísit inánes.
verses.eng: He hath filled the hungry with good things: and the rich He hath sent empty away.

verses.lat: Suscépit Israël púerum suum, recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.eng: He hath received Israel His servant, being mindful of His mercy.

verses.lat: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros, Abraham et sémini ejus in sǽcula.
verses.eng: As He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

verses.lat: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

parts.lat: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
parts.eng: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
parts.label: Pater Noster
parts.rubric: Said silently.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera. Per Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: O Lord, almighty God, who hast brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us in the same by Thy power; that during this day we may fall into no sin, but that all our words may proceed and all our thoughts and works be directed to the doing of Thy justice. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
parts.eng: O Lord, hear my prayer.
parts.latR: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
parts.engR: And let my cry come unto Thee.

parts.label: Conclusion
parts.lat: Benedicámus Dómino. Deo grátias.
parts.eng: Let us bless the Lord. Thanks be to God.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Fidélium ánimæ, per misericórdiam Dei, requiéscant in pace.
parts.eng: May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

name: Completórium
intro: The night prayer and the Church's last word before sleep. Opens with the Confiteor, moves through psalmody to the Nunc Dimittis and the Marian antiphon. The same psalms are prayed every night.

parts.label: Blessing
parts.lat: Iube, dómne, benedícere.
parts.eng: Pray, sir, a blessing.
parts.latR: Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens. Amen.
parts.engR: May the almighty Lord grant us a quiet night and a perfect end. Amen.

parts.label: Short Reading (1 Peter 5:8-9)
parts.lat: Frátres: sóbrii estóte, et vigiláte: quia adversárius vester diábolus tamquam leo rúgiens círcuit, quærens quem dévoret: cui resístite fortes in fide.
parts.eng: Brethren: be sober and watch; for your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about seeking whom he may devour. Resist ye him, strong in faith.
parts.latR: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis. Deo grátias.
parts.engR: But Thou, O Lord, have mercy on us. Thanks be to God.

parts.label: Confiteor
parts.lat:
Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Joánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, ómnibus Sanctis, et vobis, fratres: quia peccávi nimis cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ideo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Joánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, omnes Sanctos, et vos, fratres, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.

Misereátur nostri omnípotens Deus, et, dimíssis peccátis nostris, perdúcat nos ad vitam ætérnam. Amen.

Indulgéntiam, absolutiónem, et remissiónem peccatórum nostrórum tríbuat nobis omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus. Amen.
parts.eng:
I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, to all the Saints, and to you, brethren: that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word, and deed: through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, all the Saints, and you, brethren, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

May almighty God have mercy upon us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. Amen.

May the almighty and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution, and remission of our sins. Amen.

parts.label: Supplication
parts.lat: Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster.
parts.eng: Convert us, O God our Saviour.
parts.latR: Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
parts.engR: And turn away Thine anger from us.

parts.label: Opening
parts.lat: Deus, in adjutórium meum inténde.
parts.eng: O God, come to my assistance.
parts.latR: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína. Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
parts.engR: O Lord, make haste to help me. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.

parts.label: Hymn
parts.title: Te lucis ante términum
parts.lat:
Te lucis ante términum,
rerum Creátor, póscimus,
ut pro tua cleméntia
sis præsul et custódia. Procul recédant sómnia,
et nóctium phantásmata;
hostémque nostrum cómprime,
ne polluántur córpora. Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
cum Spíritu Paráclito
regnans per omne sǽculum. Amen.
parts.eng:
To Thee before the close of day,
Creator of the world, we pray:
that with Thy wonted favour Thou
wouldst be our guard and keeper now. From all ill dreams defend our sight,
from fears and terrors of the night;
withhold from us our ghostly foe,
that spot of sin we may not know. O Father, that we ask be done,
through Jesus Christ, Thine only Son,
who, with the Holy Ghost and Thee,
shall live and reign eternally. Amen.

parts.label: Antiphon
parts.lat: Miserére mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
parts.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer.

verses.lat: Cum invocárem, exaudívit me Deus justítiæ meæ: in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.
verses.eng: When I called upon Him, the God of my justice heard me: when I was in distress, Thou hast enlarged me.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

verses.lat: Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? Ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?
verses.eng: O ye sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? Why do you love vanity and seek after lying?

verses.lat: Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.
verses.eng: Know ye also that the Lord hath made His holy one wonderful: the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto Him.

verses.lat: Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.
verses.eng: Be angry and sin not: the things you say in your hearts, be sorry for them upon your beds.

verses.lat: Sacrificáte sacrifícium justítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?
verses.eng: Offer up the sacrifice of justice, and trust in the Lord. Many say: Who showeth us good things?

verses.lat: Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.
verses.eng: The light of Thy countenance, O Lord, is signed upon us: Thou hast given gladness in my heart.

verses.lat: A fructu fruménti, vini et ólei sui, multiplicáti sunt.
verses.eng: By the fruit of their corn, their wine, and oil, they are multiplied.

verses.lat: In pace in idípsum dórmiam et requiéscam:
verses.eng: In peace in the selfsame I will sleep and I will rest:

verses.lat: Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe constituísti me.
verses.eng: For Thou, O Lord, singularly hast settled me in hope.

verses.lat: Qui hábitat in adjutório Altíssimi, in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
verses.eng: He that dwelleth in the aid of the Most High shall abide under the protection of the God of heaven.

verses.lat: Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu et refúgium meum: Deus meus, sperábo in eum.
verses.eng: He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector and my refuge: my God, in Him will I trust.

verses.lat: Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, et a verbo áspero.
verses.eng: For He hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters, and from the sharp word.

verses.lat: Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi, et sub pennis ejus sperábis.
verses.eng: He will overshadow thee with His shoulders, and under His wings thou shalt trust.

verses.lat: Scuto circúmdabit te véritas ejus: non timébis a timóre noctúrno,
verses.eng: His truth shall compass thee with a shield: thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night,

verses.lat: A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris, ab incúrsu et dæmónio meridiáno.
verses.eng: Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark, of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

verses.lat: Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: ad te autem non appropinquábit.
verses.eng: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand: but it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis, et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
verses.eng: But thou shalt consider with thy eyes, and shalt see the reward of the wicked.

verses.lat: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
verses.eng: Because Thou, O Lord, art my hope: Thou hast made the Most High thy refuge.

verses.lat: Non accédet ad te malum, et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
verses.eng: There shall no evil come to thee, nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

verses.lat: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
verses.eng: For He hath given His Angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.lat: In mánibus portábunt te, ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
verses.eng: In their hands they shall bear thee up, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.lat: Super áspidem et basilíscum ambulábis, et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
verses.eng: Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

verses.lat: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
verses.eng: Because he hoped in Me I will deliver him: I will protect him because he hath known My name.

verses.lat: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
verses.eng: He shall cry to Me, and I will hear him: I am with him in tribulation: I will deliver him and I will glorify him.

verses.lat: Longitúdine diérum replébo eum, et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
verses.eng: I will fill him with length of days, and I will show him My salvation.

verses.lat: Ecce nunc benedícite Dóminum, omnes servi Dómini:
verses.eng: Behold, now bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord:

verses.lat: Qui statis in domo Dómini, in átriis domus Dei nostri.
verses.eng: Who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.lat: In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, et benedícite Dóminum.
verses.eng: In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, and bless ye the Lord.

verses.lat: Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.eng: May the Lord out of Sion bless thee, He that made heaven and earth.

parts.label: Capitulum
parts.lat: Tu autem in nobis es, Dómine, et nomen sanctum tuum invocátum est super nos: ne derelínquas nos, Dómine Deus noster.
parts.eng: But Thou, O Lord, art among us, and Thy holy name is called upon by us: forsake us not, O Lord our God.

parts.label: Responsory
parts.v1Lat: In manus tuas, Dómine, comméndo spíritum meum.
parts.v1Eng: Into Thy hands, O Lord, I commend my spirit.
parts.r1Eng: Thou hast redeemed us, O Lord, the God of truth.
parts.v2Lat: Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi.
parts.v2Eng: Keep us, O Lord, as the apple of Thine eye.
parts.r2Lat: Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos.
parts.r2Eng: Protect us under the shadow of Thy wings.

parts.label: Canticum Simeónis; Nunc Dimittis
parts.antiphonLat: Salva nos, * Dómine, vigilántes, custódi nos dormiéntes; ut vigilémus cum Christo, et requiescámus in pace.
parts.antiphonEng: Protect us, * Lord, while we are awake and safeguard us while we sleep; that we may keep watch with Christ, and rest in peace.

verses.lat: Nunc dimíttis servum tuum, Dómine, secúndum verbum tuum in pace:
verses.eng: Now Thou dost dismiss Thy servant, O Lord, according to Thy word in peace:

verses.lat: Quia vidérunt óculi mei salutáre tuum,
verses.eng: Because my eyes have seen Thy salvation,

verses.lat: Quod parásti ante fáciem ómnium populórum:
verses.eng: Which Thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples:

verses.lat: Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.
verses.eng: A light to the revelation of the Gentiles, and the glory of Thy people Israel.

parts.lat: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
parts.eng: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
parts.label: Pater Noster
parts.rubric: Said silently.

parts.label: Collect
parts.lat: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Angeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant. Per Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum. Amen.
parts.eng: Visit, we beseech Thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it all snares of the enemy: let Thy holy Angels dwell herein, to preserve us in peace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.

parts.label: Marian Antiphon; Salve Regína
parts.lat: Salve, Regína, Mater misericórdiæ, vita, dulcédo et spes nostra, salve. Ad te clamámus, éxsules fílii Hevæ. Ad te suspirámus, geméntes et flentes in hac lacrimárum valle. Eja ergo, advocáta nostra, illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte. Et Jesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui, nobis post hoc exsílium osténde. O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
parts.eng: Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope. To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve. To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious Advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us. And after this our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

name: Officium Defunctorum
intro: The Office for the Faithful Departed (Officium Defunctorum). Prayed on All Souls' Day, anniversaries of death, and at funerals. Comprises Matins (three nocturns with nine lessons from Job and the great responsories), Lauds, and Vespers. The Gloria Patri is replaced throughout by Réquiem ætérnam.

parts.label: Pater Noster, Ave María, Credo (silently)
parts.lat: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
parts.eng: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
parts.rubric: Said silently.

parts.label: Versicle & Response
parts.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries.
parts.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips.
parts.latR: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
parts.engR: And my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

parts.label: Invitatory Antiphon
parts.lat: Regem, cui ómnia vivunt, * Veníte adorémus.
parts.eng: Unto the Eternal King all live. * O come, let us worship Him.

verses.lat: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, jubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem ejus in confessióne, et in psalmis jubilémus ei.
verses.eng: Come, let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our Saviour. Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to Him with psalms.

verses.lat: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos: quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu ejus sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
verses.eng: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods: for the Lord will not cast off His people: for in His hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are His.

verses.lat: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus ejus: veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus Deus noster; nos autem pópulus ejus, et oves páscuæ ejus.
verses.eng: For the sea is His, and He made it, and His hands formed the dry land: come, let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us, for He is the Lord our God; and we are the people of His pasture, and the sheep of His hand.

verses.lat: Hódie si vocem ejus audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
verses.eng: Today if you shall hear His voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted Me, they proved Me and saw My works.

verses.lat: Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde; ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus jurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
verses.eng: Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart; and they have not known My ways: so I swore in My wrath: They shall not enter into My rest.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine: et lux perpétua lúceat eis.
verses.eng: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord: and let perpetual light shine upon them.

parts.label: Psalmus 5
parts.antiphonLat: Dírige, * Dómine, Deus meus, in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
parts.antiphonEng: Make my way straight before thy face, * O Lord my God.

verses.lat: Verba mea áuribus pércipe, Dómine, * intéllege clamórem meum.
verses.eng: Give ear, O Lord, to my words * understand my cry.

verses.lat: Inténde voci oratiónis meæ, * Rex meus et Deus meus.
verses.eng: Hearken to the voice of my prayer, * O my King and my God.

verses.lat: Quóniam ad te orábo: * Dómine, mane exáudies vocem meam.
verses.eng: For to thee will I pray: * O Lord, in the morning thou shalt hear my voice.

verses.lat: Mane astábo tibi et vidébo: * quóniam non Deus volens iniquitátem tu es.
verses.eng: In the morning I will stand before thee, and will see: * because thou art not a God that willest iniquity.

verses.lat: Neque habitábit juxta te malígnus: * neque permanébunt injústi ante óculos tuos.
verses.eng: Neither shall the wicked dwell near thee: * nor shall the unjust abide before thy eyes.

verses.lat: Odísti omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem: * perdes omnes, qui loquúntur mendácium.
verses.eng: Thou hatest all the workers of iniquity: * thou wilt destroy all that speak a lie.

verses.lat: Virum sánguinum et dolósum abominábitur Dóminus: * (8a) ego autem in multitúdine misericórdiæ tuæ.
verses.eng: The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor. * (8a) But as for me in the multitude of thy mercy,

verses.lat: Introíbo in domum tuam: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum in timóre tuo.
verses.eng: I will come into thy house; * I will worship towards thy holy temple, in thy fear.

verses.lat: Dómine, deduc me in justítia tua: * propter inimícos meos dírige in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
verses.eng: Conduct me, O Lord, in thy justice: * because of my enemies, direct my way in thy sight.

verses.lat: Quóniam non est in ore eórum véritas: * cor eórum vanum est.
verses.eng: For there is no truth in their mouth: * their heart is vain.

verses.lat: Sepúlcrum patens est guttur eórum, † linguis suis dolóse agébant, * júdica illos, Deus.
verses.eng: Their throat is an open sepulchre: † they dealt deceitfully with their tongues: * judge them, O God.

verses.lat: Décidant a cogitatiónibus suis, † secúndum multitúdinem impietátum eórum expélle eos, * quóniam irritavérunt te, Dómine.
verses.eng: Let them fall from their devices: † according to the multitude of their wickednesses cast them out: * for they have provoked thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et læténtur omnes, qui sperant in te, * in ætérnum exsultábunt: et habitábis in eis.
verses.eng: But let all them be glad that hope in thee: * they shall rejoice for ever, and thou shalt dwell in them.

verses.lat: Et gloriabúntur in te omnes, qui díligunt nomen tuum, * (13a) quóniam tu benedíces justo.
verses.eng: And all they that love thy name shall glory in thee: * (13a) For thou wilt bless the just.

verses.lat: Dómine, ut scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ * coronásti nos.
verses.eng: O Lord, thou hast crowned us, * as with a shield of thy good will.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.rubric: Recited in full according to the Vulgate psalter; concluded with Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine: et lux perpétua lúceat eis, in place of Glória Patri.

parts.label: Psalmus 6
