O God, who art thyself at once the Maker and the Redeemer of all thy faithful ones, grant unto the souls of thy servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, making of our entreaties unto our great Father a mean whereby they may have that forgiveness which they have ever hoped for. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine.
parts.eng: O Lord, grant them eternal rest.
parts.engR: And let the everlasting light shine upon them.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Requiéscant in pace.
parts.eng: May they rest in peace.

parts.label: Pater Noster, Ave María (silently)
parts.lat:
Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.

Ave María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum. Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Jesus. Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
parts.eng:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
parts.rubric: Said silently.

parts.label: Psalmus 114; Diléxi
parts.antiphonLat: Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
parts.antiphonEng: I will walk before the Lord * in the land of the living.

verses.lat: Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.
verses.eng: I have loved, because the Lord will hear * the voice of my prayer.

verses.lat: Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.
verses.eng: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me: * and in my days I will call upon him.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et perícula inférni invenérunt me.
verses.eng: The sorrows of death have compassed me: * and the perils of hell have found me.

verses.lat: Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * (4a) et nomen Dómini invocávi.
verses.eng: I met with trouble and sorrow: * (4a) and I called upon the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: ‡ (5) miséricors Dóminus, et justus, * et Deus noster miserétur.
verses.eng: O Lord, deliver my soul. ‡ (5) The Lord is merciful and just, * and our God sheweth mercy.

verses.lat: Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.
verses.eng: The Lord is the keeper of little ones: * I was humbled, and he delivered me.

verses.lat: Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.
verses.eng: Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: * for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

verses.lat: Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: ‡ óculos meos a lácrimis, * pedes meos a lapsu.
verses.eng: For he hath delivered my soul from death: ‡ my eyes from tears, * my feet from falling.

verses.lat: Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
verses.eng: I will please the Lord * in the land of the living.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.label: Psalmus 119; Ad Dóminum
parts.antiphonLat: Heu mihi Dómine, * quia incolátus meus prolongátus est.
parts.antiphonEng: Woe is me! O Lord, * that my sojourn is long.

verses.lat: Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.
verses.eng: In my trouble I cried to the Lord: * and he heard me.

verses.lat: Dómine, líbera ánimam meam a lábiis iníquis, * et a lingua dolósa.
verses.eng: O Lord, deliver my soul from wicked lips, * and a deceitful tongue.

verses.lat: Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponátur tibi * ad linguam dolósam?
verses.eng: What shall be given to thee, or what shall be added to thee, * to a deceitful tongue?

verses.lat: Sagíttæ poténtis acútæ, * cum carbónibus desolatóriis.
verses.eng: The sharp arrows of the mighty, * with coals that lay waste.

verses.lat: Heu mihi, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est: † habitávi cum habitántibus Cedar: * (6) multum íncola fuit ánima mea.
verses.eng: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! † I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar: * (6) my soul hath been long a sojourner.

verses.lat: Cum his, qui odérunt pacem, eram pacíficus: * cum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
verses.eng: With them that hated peace I was peaceable: * when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.rubric: Recited in full according to the Vulgate psalter; concluded with Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine: et lux perpétua lúceat eis, in place of Glória Patri.

parts.label: Psalmus 120; Levávi óculos
parts.antiphonLat: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
parts.antiphonEng: The Lord shall keep thee from all evil, * the Lord shall keep thy soul.

verses.lat: Levávi óculos meos in montes, * unde véniet auxílium mihi.
verses.eng: I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, * from whence help shall come to me.

verses.lat: Auxílium meum a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.eng: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

verses.lat: Non det in commotiónem pedem tuum: * neque dormítet qui custódit te.
verses.eng: May he not suffer thy foot to be moved: * neither let him slumber that keepeth thee.

verses.lat: Ecce, non dormitábit neque dórmiet, * qui custódit Israël.
verses.eng: Behold he shall neither slumber nor sleep, * that keepeth Israel.

verses.lat: Dóminus custódit te, Dóminus protéctio tua, * super manum déxteram tuam.
verses.eng: The Lord is thy keeper, the Lord is thy protection * upon thy right hand.

verses.lat: Per diem sol non uret te: * neque luna per noctem.
verses.eng: The sun shall not burn thee by day: * nor the moon by night.

verses.lat: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
verses.eng: The Lord keepeth thee from all evil: * may the Lord keep thy soul.

verses.lat: Dóminus custódiat intróitum tuum, et éxitum tuum: * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: May the Lord keep thy coming in and thy going out; * from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.label: Psalmus 129; De profúndis
parts.antiphonLat: Si iniquitátes * observáveris, Dómine: Dómine, quis sustinébit?
parts.antiphonEng: If Thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, * O Lord, who shall stand.

verses.lat: De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:
verses.eng: Out of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord: * Lord, hear my voice.

verses.lat: Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: Let thy ears be attentive * to the voice of my supplication.

verses.lat: Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?
verses.eng: If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: * Lord, who shall stand it.

verses.lat: Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.
verses.eng: For with thee there is merciful forgiveness: * and by reason of thy law, I have waited for thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo ejus: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.
verses.eng: My soul hath relied on his word: * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

verses.lat: A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.
verses.eng: From the morning watch even until night, * let Israel hope in the Lord.

verses.lat: Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
verses.eng: Because with the Lord there is mercy: * and with him plentiful redemption.

verses.lat: Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus ejus.
verses.eng: And he shall redeem Israel * from all his iniquities.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.label: Psalmus 137; Confitébor tibi
parts.antiphonLat: Opera * mánuum tuárum, Dómine, ne despícias.
parts.antiphonEng: O Lord, forsake not * the works of thine own hands.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * quóniam audísti verba oris mei.
verses.eng: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: * for thou hast heard the words of my mouth.

verses.lat: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
verses.eng: I will sing praise to thee in the sight of the Angels: * I will worship towards thy holy temple, and I will give glory to thy name.

verses.lat: Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * quóniam magnificásti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.
verses.eng: For thy mercy, and for thy truth: * for thou hast magnified thy holy name

verses.lat: In quacúmque die invocávero te, exáudi me: * multiplicábis in ánima mea virtútem.
verses.eng: In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me: * thou shalt multiply strength in my soul.

verses.lat: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, omnes reges terræ: * quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui:
verses.eng: May all the kings of the earth give glory to thee: * for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.

verses.lat: Et cantent in viis Dómini: * quóniam magna est glória Dómini.
verses.eng: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord: * for great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.lat: Quóniam excélsus Dóminus, et humília réspicit: * et alta a longe cognóscit.
verses.eng: For the Lord is high, and looketh on the low: * and the high he knoweth afar off.

verses.lat: Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis, vivificábis me: * et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit déxtera tua.
verses.eng: If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, thou wilt quicken me: * and thou hast stretched forth thy hand against the wrath of my enemies: and thy right hand hath saved me.

verses.lat: Dóminus retríbuet pro me: * Dómine, misericórdia tua in sǽculum: ópera mánuum tuárum ne despícias.
verses.eng: The Lord will repay for me: * thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: O despise not the works of thy hands.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Audívi vocem de cælo dicéntem mihi.
parts.eng: I heard a voice from heaven, saying unto me:
parts.latR: Beáti mórtui qui in Dómino moriúntur.
parts.engR: Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord.

parts.label: Antiphon ad Magníficat
parts.lat: Omne * quod dat mihi Pater, ad me véniet; et eum qui venit ad me, non eíciam foras.
parts.eng: All that the Father giveth Me shall come to Me; * and him that cometh to Me I will in no wise cast out.

verses.lat: Magníficat * ánima mea Dóminum.
verses.eng: My soul * doth magnify the Lord.

verses.lat: Et exsultávit spíritus meus * in Deo, salutári meo.
verses.eng: And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

verses.lat: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
verses.eng: Because He hath regarded the humility of His handmaid: * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

verses.lat: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen ejus.
verses.eng: Because He that is mighty hath done great things to me: * and holy is His name.

verses.lat: Et misericórdia ejus a progénie in progénies * timéntibus eum.
verses.eng: And His mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Fecit poténtiam in bráchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
verses.eng: He hath showed might in His arm: * He hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

verses.lat: Depósuit poténtes de sede, * et exaltávit húmiles.
verses.eng: He hath put down the mighty from their seat, * and hath exalted the humble.

verses.lat: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
verses.eng: He hath filled the hungry with good things: * and the rich He hath sent empty away.

verses.lat: Suscépit Israël púerum suum, * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.eng: He hath received Israel His servant, * being mindful of His mercy.

verses.lat: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros, * Abraham, et sémini ejus in sǽcula.
verses.eng: As He spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.label: Antiphon ad Magníficat (repeated)
parts.lat: Omne * quod dat mihi Pater, ad me véniet; et eum qui venit ad me, non eíciam foras.
parts.eng: All that the Father giveth Me shall come to Me; * and him that cometh to Me I will in no wise cast out.

parts.label: Kýrie
parts.lat: Kýrie, eléison. Christe, eléison. Kýrie, eléison.
parts.eng: Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy. Lord, have mercy.

parts.label: Pater Noster (silently to ‘Et ne nos’)
parts.lat: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum. Advéniat regnum tuum. Fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie, et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem, sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
parts.eng: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
parts.rubric: Said silently to ‘Et ne nos inducas’.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem.
parts.eng: And lead us not into temptation.

verses.lat: Lauda, ánima mea, Dóminum, laudábo Dóminum in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo quámdiu fúero.
verses.eng: Praise the Lord, O my soul, in my life I will praise the Lord: * I will sing to my God as long as I shall be.

verses.lat: Nolíte confídere in princípibus: * in fíliis hóminum, in quibus non est salus.
verses.eng: Put not your trust in princes: * in the children of men, in whom there is no salvation.

verses.lat: Exíbit spíritus ejus, et revertétur in terram suam: * in illa die períbunt omnes cogitatiónes eórum.
verses.eng: His spirit shall go forth, and he shall return into his earth: * in that day all their thoughts shall perish.

verses.lat: Beátus, cujus Deus Jacob adjútor ejus, spes ejus in Dómino, Deo ipsíus: * qui fecit cælum et terram, mare, et ómnia, quæ in eis sunt.
verses.eng: Blessed is he who hath the God of Jacob for his helper, whose hope is in the Lord his God: * who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that are in them.

verses.lat: Qui custódit veritátem in sǽculum, facit judícium injúriam patiéntibus: * dat escam esuriéntibus.
verses.eng: Who keepeth truth for ever: who executeth judgment for them that suffer wrong: * who giveth food to the hungry.

verses.lat: Dóminus solvit compedítos: * Dóminus illúminat cæcos.
verses.eng: The Lord looseth them that are fettered: * the Lord enlighteneth the blind.

verses.lat: Dóminus érigit elísos, * Dóminus díligit justos.
verses.eng: The Lord lifteth up them that are cast down, * the Lord loveth the just.

verses.lat: Dóminus custódit ádvenas, pupíllum et víduam suscípiet: * et vias peccatórum dispérdet.
verses.eng: The Lord keepeth the strangers, He will support the fatherless and the widow: * and the ways of sinners He will destroy.

verses.lat: Regnábit Dóminus in sǽcula, Deus tuus, Sion, * in generatiónem et generatiónem.
verses.eng: The Lord shall reign for ever: thy God, O Sion, * unto generation and generation.

verses.lat: Réquiem ætérnam * dona eis, Dómine.
verses.eng: Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.

verses.lat: Et lux perpétua * lúceat eis.
verses.eng: And let perpetual light * shine upon them.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: A porta ínferi.
parts.eng: From the gates of hell.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Requiéscant in pace.
parts.eng: May they rest in peace.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
parts.eng: O Lord, hear my prayer.
parts.latR: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
parts.engR: And let my cry come unto Thee.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Dóminus vobíscum.
parts.eng: The Lord be with you.

parts.label: Collect; Fidélium, Deus
parts.lat: Orémus. Fidélium, Deus, ómnium Cónditor et Redémptor, animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum: ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
parts.eng: Let us pray. O God, who art thyself at once the Maker and the Redeemer of all thy faithful ones, grant unto the souls of thy servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, making of our entreaties unto our great Father a mean whereby they may have that forgiveness which they have ever hoped for. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine.
parts.eng: O Lord, grant them eternal rest.
parts.engR: And let the everlasting light shine upon them.

parts.label: Versicle
parts.lat: Requiéscant in pace.
parts.eng: May they rest in peace.
